question: Ram and Ramesh run two kilometres and Ram wins by 40 seconds. Ram and Naresh run two kilometres and Ram wins by 650 metres. When Ramesh and Naresh run the same distance, Ramesh wins by 25 seconds. Find the time taken by Ram to run two kilometres.
solution:
**Given:**

Ram wins against Ramesh by 40 seconds.

Ram wins against Naresh by 650 meters.

Ramesh wins against Naresh by 25 seconds.

**Concept:**

Relative speeds and times.

**Solution:**

Ram finishes first, Ramesh second and Naresh lastly.

Rames finishes 40 sec after Ram, Naresh finishes 25 sec after Ramesh

Naresh finishes after Ram by = 40 + 25 = 65sec

Total distance by which 
Ram wins from Naresh = 650m

Naresh will take = (65 × 2000)/650 = 200 sec

 200 sec = 180 sec + 20 sec = 3min 20sec

∴ A will take 3min 20sec - 65 sec = 2 min 15 sec

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
